newsitem.title: USA: Intel shares up amid strong tech outlooks.
newsitem.headline: Intel shares up amid strong tech outlooks.

text.p: Shares of semiconductor chip maker Intel Corp picked up steam Wednesday, trading up 2-1/2 to 98-1/4 by mid-afternoon on strong outlooks provided by key personal computer and networking companies, analysts said.

Tuesday, Dell Computer Corp said it sees surging demand from owners of older personal computer upgrading their systems as helping boost growth. Specifically, Dell cited the move toward fast Pentium chips made by Intel.
Also on Wednesday, network equipment maker Cisco Systems Inc provided bullish acquisition-related comments at a Montgomery Securities investment conference in San Fransciso.

"People have just looked (at this late news) as a pat on the back and have gone back to buying again," said Dan Niles, analyst at Robertson Stephens and Co. "We're getting more information that this is not a fake rally."

In a statement released Wednesday from the Montgomery conference, Montgomery analyst John Joseph said he sees the inventory correction that has plagued chip makers "as being largely completed" and "year-over-year comparisons" should improve.
Along with Intel, Cisco rose 1-3/8 to 63-1/2. 3Com Corp was up 2-5/8 at 63-1/8. Compaq Computer Corp was up 1-1/4 at 65-1/2 and Dell gained 3 to 79-7/8.
